description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting  Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers.
Activate Orzhov Basilicaby tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Orzhov Basilica's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
